title: Yellow Molten Ukrainian Pork Dumplings
description: A traditional Ukrainian dish featuring pork dumplings with a sweet and spicy twist, made with gochujang and fermented ingredients, sugar-free-friendly. This recipe is perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, gochujang, sauerkraut, egg, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper, and mix until just combined.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
When ready to cook, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the pork mixture into the boiling water, about 1 tablespoon each.
Cook the dumplings for 5-7 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Remove the dumplings from the water with a slotted spoon and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or dill, if desired.
Serve the dumplings with a side of sour cream or applesauce, if desired.
